$comment: Schema for review files generated by step2_generate_review_files.py. These files contain benchmark model information, candidate LMArena matches, and automatic selection results.
description: Review file containing benchmark models, their structured information, candidates, and automatic selection

^.+$.description: Review entry for a single benchmark model, keyed by the original model name from the benchmark

benchmark_info.$comment: Structured information extracted from the benchmark model name
benchmark_info.description: Structured information extracted from the benchmark model name

family.$comment: Model family name (e.g., 'gpt', 'gemini', 'claude', 'mistral', 'llama'). Null if family cannot be determined.
family.description: Model family name (e.g., 'gpt', 'gemini', 'claude'). Null if family cannot be determined.

subfamily.$comment: Subfamily name including suffixes (e.g., 'gpt-5', 'gemini-pro-preview', 'o3'). Suffixes like 'pro', 'preview', 'flash', 'heavy', 'r1' should be included in subfamily. Null if no subfamily identified.
subfamily.description: Subfamily name including suffixes (e.g., 'gpt-5', 'gemini-pro-preview'). Null if no subfamily identified.

version.$comment: Version number standardized to float format (e.g., '3.0', '5.2'). Versions like 'v3' and '3.0' are normalized to the same format. Null if no version found.
version.description: Version number standardized to float format (e.g., '3.0', '5.2'). Null if no version found.

date.$comment: Date suffix in original format (e.g., 'dec', '2412', '1205', '2025-04-16'). No normalization or conversion required. Null if no date found.
date.description: Date suffix in original format (e.g., 'dec', '2412', '2025-04-16'). Null if no date found.

parameters.$comment: Parameter count in formats like '20B', '1B'. Exclude formats like 'thinking-32k' and 'A2B'. Null if no parameters found or format not recognized.
parameters.description: Parameter count in formats like '20B', '1B'. Null if no parameters found or format not recognized.

other_info.$comment: List of remaining information from model name not captured in other fields. Contains all remaining parts of the model name that were not extracted as family, subfamily, version, date, or parameters. Null if empty.
other_info.description: List of remaining information from model name not captured in other fields. Null if empty.

candidates.$comment: List of candidate LMArena models that match the benchmark model based on structured matching rules. If no candidates are found, contains a single entry with 'lmarena_model': 'NO_MATCH_FOUND'.
candidates.description: List of candidate LMArena models that match the benchmark model based on structured matching rules

lmarena_model.$comment: Special value indicating no matching LMArena model was found
LMArena model ID (original model name from LMArena leaderboard)

family.$comment: Model family name extracted from LMArena model name

subfamily.$comment: Subfamily name extracted from LMArena model name

version.$comment: Version number extracted from LMArena model name

date.$comment: Date suffix extracted from LMArena model name

parameters.$comment: Parameter count extracted from LMArena model name

other_info.$comment: Other information extracted from LMArena model name

untrusted.$comment: 1 = untrusted (completed by agent, requires human review), 0 = trusted (reviewed by human). Default is 1. This field does not affect subsequent processing, it only marks data rigor.
untrusted.description: 1 = untrusted (completed by agent), 0 = trusted (reviewed by human). Default is 1.

oneOf.$comment: Selected LMArena model name (automatically selected or manually confirmed)
Human-confirmed: no matching model in Study Universe (Score >= 1330)

selected_lmarena_model.$comment: The selected LMArena model, or 0 (auto no-match) or -1 (human-confirmed no-match). Automatically selected by similarity algorithm if multiple candidates exist, or set to 0 if no candidates found.
selected_lmarena_model.description: The selected LMArena model, or 0 (auto no-match) or -1 (human-confirmed no-match)
